name: paprika
description: Operate Kubernetes application delivery with Paprika: fleet status, app health, drift, releases, rollouts, gates, and pipeline control.

interface.longDescription: Inspect your delivery fleet in a side panel, view reported application health and drift evidence, investigate resource failures, and request scoped deployment actions in chat.
defaultPrompt: Show fleet status and any unhealthy applications.
Investigate the most recent failed release.
What drifted out of sync on my apps?
